name: @starter/agentic
description: A Node and TypeScript base for projects built by parallel coding agents in separate Git worktrees.

scripts.postinstall: npx -y skills@1.5.22 add jssblck/agents -a claude-code -a codex -y
scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.policy:check: nudge validate && node tools/check-nudge-rules.ts && nudge check && bastion validate && eph check
scripts.ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run policy:check
